in_hebrew.name: Armington
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Armington הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old English 'arming' meaning 'powerful' and 'ton' meaning 'town'. This name was given to those who lived in or came from powerful towns.
